description: This file defines an actor `DiagnosticsFileLog` responsible for logging diagnostic events into a JSON Lines file, with support for log rotation, directory management, and optional enabling via user defaults.

classes.name: DiagnosticsFileLog
classes.description: An actor handling logging diagnostics data to a file with support for rotation, directory creation, and enabling control through user defaults.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: logDirectoryURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: logFileURL
methods.description: Returns the full URL of the log file.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a new diagnostic event with specified category, event, and optional fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the log file and backups, effectively clearing logs.

properties.name: maxBytes
properties.description: Maximum size in bytes before log rotation occurs.

properties.name: maxBackups
properties.description: Maximum number of backup log files to keep.

inner_structs.name: Record
inner_structs.description: Structure representing a log record, Codable for JSON encoding.

private_methods.name: write
private_methods.description: Enqueues a record to be written to the log file.

private_methods.name: ensureDirectory
private_methods.description: Creates the log directory if it doesn't exist.

private_methods.name: append
private_methods.description: Appends a JSON-encoded record to the log file.

private_methods.name: rotateIfNeeded
private_methods.description: Performs log rotation if file exceeds max size.

private_methods.name: rotatedURL
private_methods.description: Constructs URL for a rotated log file based on index.
